responsibility: Declares `Go_optimize`, the per-optimization flag object used to register named Go frontend optimization controls and test whether a given frontend optimization is enabled. This header provides the lightweight common mechanism that optimization-sensitive passes use to bind behavior to `-fgo-optimize-XXX` options.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `Go_optimize` flag object used to register and query frontend optimization switches. Unlike go-optimize.cc, it defines the per-optimization interface only, not the global registry or option-processing implementation.
